name: image_upscale_flow
description: One call: prompt to a 1080p image — the make stage generates (krea-2 or z-image via the image-gen card), the polish stage upscales (SeedVR2 1080p via the upscale-tools card, always on). WHAT it produces: the upscaled image artifact. HOW it runs: both stages are card=, so the {flow:} door submits ONE merged run (validate then start); the image_upscale POST tool runs the same row in one call; the two cards also drive one at a time through the {model:} door or the bench. Knobs: image_model (required, no default) — krea-2 or z-image, picks the generator family and its baked graph; prompt (required) — what to generate, up to 4000 chars; seed (optional) — sampler seed on both stages; omit it and each stage's card default applies (fresh takes, minted per run).

image_model.description: Required. Generator family: krea-2 or z-image (no default — the call names its family).

prompt.description: Required. What to generate (up to 4000 chars); an empty one refuses at the door.

seed.description: Optional. Sampler seed, range 0..2147483647, stamped onto both stages — omit for fresh takes (each stage's card mints one).

width.description: Optional. Make canvas width (16-step, 256–2048; state the operator's class, e.g. 1344) — stamped onto the make stage.

height.description: Optional. Make canvas height (16-step, 256–2048; e.g. 768) — stamped onto the make stage.

resolution.description: Optional. SeedVR2 target short side (256–2160; 1080 = the FHD rail, state twice the make short side to double, e.g. 1536) — stamped onto the polish stage.
